answer: A vault pools weight only if gale tags every claimed head and finds it bonded; the lowest bond is recorded as nadir, and the next head under that vault must lift nadir to the next ledge for all heads. First: 1 iron. Second makes nadir 2 for both, 4 total; third makes nadir 3 for all, 9. n clones lock n^2 iron; fresh vaults cannot pool.
